about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "March of The Dwarves". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the D&D genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows:

D0006: March of The Dwarves

Experience the mining culture of the mountain dwarves, with their marches designed to withstand the pace of their heavy work
Paid Dimension (DLC)

- Genre: D&D

- Tracks:

  • March 1 (theme for serious moments)

  • March 2 (theme for playful and joyful moments)

  • Battle (theme for Combat)

  • Rest (theme for Calm moments)

  • Mines (theme for Underground scenery)

- Composer: Vinicius Meireles
